title: 'Miracle on Mississippi' - All passengers rescued after New Orleans cruise ship collision
english: A cruise ship carrying 130 people capsized in the Mississippi River near New Orleans after colliding with a tanker vessel. While 32 passengers were hospitalized with minor injuries, all individuals on board were safely accounted for during the rescue operation. Authorities are currently investigating a suspected steering failure as the cause of the accident, which officials are calling a miracle due to the successful survival of everyone involved.
amharic: በኒው ኦርሊንስ አቅራቢያ በሚገኘው የሚሲሲፒ ወንዝ ላይ 130 ሰዎችን የጫነ የክሩዝ መርከብ ከታንከር መርከብ ጋር በመጋጨቱ ምክንያት ተገልብጧል። በደረሰው አደጋ 32 ተሳፋሪዎች ቀላል ጉዳት ደርሶባቸው ወደ ሆስፒታል ቢወሰዱም፣ በመርከቧ ላይ የነበሩ ሁሉም ሰዎች በሕይወት መትረፋቸው ተረጋግጧል። ባለሥልጣናት የአደጋውን መንስኤ በመመርመር ላይ ሲሆኑ፣ የመርከቧ መሪ መበላሸት ለግጭቱ ምክንያት እንደሆነ ተገምቷል፤ ሁሉም ሰው በሕይወት በመትረፉም ሁኔታው እንደ ተአምር ተወስዷል።
oromo: Niiw Orliinsitti doonii namoota 130 baattee deemaa turte tokko markaba gurguddaa (tanker) waliin walitti buunee laga Misisiipii keessatti garagaltee. Namoota 32 irratti miidhaan salphaan ga'ee gara hospitaalaatti geessaman malee, namni doonii sanarra ture hundi nagaadhaan lubbuun hafeera. Aangoonni mootummaa sababa balaa kanaa qorachaa jiru yoo ta'u, dooniin sun to'annoo ala ta'uun isaa shakkuufi. Namni tokkollee utuu hin du'in lubbuun hafuun isaa kana dinqisiifannaan "tajaajila" jedhamee ibsameera.

title: Setback for SpaceX Starship rocket's double-catch test
english: SpaceX faced a challenge during its latest Starship test flight when it had to abort the attempt to catch the rocket's booster with mechanical arms. Instead of landing at the launch site, the booster was guided to an ocean landing where it caught fire. The mission's upper stage successfully reached space to deploy satellites, and the company will determine if it is safe to attempt a recovery of that section later in the flight.
amharic: SpaceX በቅርብ ጊዜ ባደረገው የስታርሺፕ የሙከራ በረራ የሮኬቱን መለስተኛ ክፍል በሜካኒካል እጆች ለመያዝ የነበረው ሙከራ ሳይሳካ ቀርቷል። የሮኬቱ የታችኛው ክፍል ወደ ማስጀመሪያው ጣቢያ ከመመለስ ይልቅ ወደ ውቅያኖስ እንዲያመራ ተደርጎ እዚያም በእሳት ተቃጥሏል። የሮኬቱ የላይኛው ክፍል ሳተላይቶችን ለመላክ ወደ ጠፈር መድረሱን የቀጠለ ሲሆን፣ ኩባንያው ይህንን ክፍል በሌላ ጊዜ ለመያዝ ይቻል እንደሆነ እየገመገመ ይገኛል።
oromo: SpaceX yaalii balalii qormaata isaa kan dhihoo kanaa irratti, kutaa gadii rookeetii 'Starship' harka maashinii fayyadamnee ni qabanna jedhee ture milkaa'uu hin dandeenye. Kutaan rookeetii kun gara lafaatti deebi'ee iddoo itti qabamu irra bu'uu mannaa, gara galaanaatti akka darbatamu taasifamee ibiddaan gubateera. Kutaan ol-aanaan rookeetichaa gara hawaatti ergamee ergaa 'satellite' raabsuu isaa itti fufeera, akkasumas dhaabbatichi kutaa kana gara fuulduraatti qabachuu akka danda'uuf murtii darbuuf qophiirra jira.

title: Tanker collision leaves riverboat passengers clinging to railings
english: A passenger riverboat docked in New Orleans was struck by a tanker ship, causing the vessel to partially sink. The impact forced those on board to hold onto railings for safety while awaiting help. Thankfully, emergency responders were able to successfully rescue all passengers and crew members involved in the accident.
amharic: ኒው ኦርሊንስ ውስጥ ተንሳፋፊ የወንዝ ጀልባ ከታንከር መርከብ ጋር በመጋጨቷ ምክንያት ጀልባዋ በከፊል ሰጥማለች። ይህ አደጋ በጀልባዋ ላይ የነበሩ ተሳፋሪዎች ለደህንነታቸው ሲሉ የጀልባዋን መወጣጫዎች ተጠቅመው እንዲንጠለጠሉ አስገድዷቸዋል። ይሁን እንጂ ሁሉም ተሳፋሪዎች እና ሰራተኞች በነፍስ አድን ሰራተኞች አማካኝነት በሰላም መዳን ችለዋል።
oromo: Niiw Orliins keessatti dooniin imaltootaa qarqara lagaatti dhaabattee jirtu doonii gurguddaa boba'aa feettu tokkoon erga rukutamee booda gartuu tokko bishaan jalatti liqimfameera. Balaa kanaan kanneen doonii keessa turan lubbuu isaanii oolchuuf jirma dooniitti qabatanii turan. Haata'u malee, ogeeyyiin gargaarsa ariifachiisaa balaa kana booda imaltootaa fi hojjettoota hunda nagaan baasuu danda'aniiru.

title: Former FAA official says ‘nobody really knows what is going on’
english: A former FAA official, Kyle Bailey, has expressed concern regarding a widespread telecommunications outage that led to the grounding of all flights across the United States. He noted that the situation is unclear, as authorities do not yet fully understand the root cause of the technical failure. Consequently, he believes that keeping aircraft on the ground is the most prudent safety measure until the issue is resolved.
amharic: የቀድሞው የፌዴራል አቪዬሽን አስተዳደር (FAA) ባለስልጣን ካይል ቤይሊ፣ በአሜሪካ በመላው ሀገሪቱ የተከሰተውን የቴሌኮሙኒኬሽን መቆራረጥ ተከትሎ በረራዎች ሁሉ እንዲቆሙ መደረጉን ገልጸዋል። የቴክኒክ ችግሩ መንስኤ ምን እንደሆነ በግልጽ ስላልታወቀ፣ ሁኔታው ግራ የሚያጋባ መሆኑን ተናግረዋል። ይህንን ችግር ለመፍታት እና ደህንነትን ለማረጋገጥ አውሮፕላኖች መሬት ላይ መቆየታቸው አሁን ባለው ሁኔታ ትክክለኛው ውሳኔ እንደሆነም ጠቁመዋል።
oromo: Hoggantoonni duraanii FAA, Kyle Bailey, rakkoo quunnamtii teknooloojii guutuu biyyattii mudateen walqabatee balalii xiyyaaraa hunduu akka dhaabbatan ibsaniiru. Sababa rakkoo kanaa adda baasuun waan hin danda'amneef, haalli jiru baay'ee gaaffii keessa akka jiru ibsan. Kanaafuu, hanga rakkoon kun furamutti xiyyaarotni lafarra turuun isaanii nagaa fi tasgabbii eeguuf murtoo sirrii ta'uu dubbataniiru.

title: UK police open sex offence probe into comedian and author David Walliams
english: British police have launched an investigation into comedian and author David Walliams following multiple allegations of historical sexual abuse and grooming. These accusations, detailed in recent reports, claim the misconduct involved teenagers and younger colleagues dating back to 2003. Walliams has formally denied all wrongdoing, asserting that he has never broken the law or acted as a sexual predator. In response to the scandal, his publisher and talent agency have cut ties with him, and the BBC has removed his programs from its platforms.
amharic: የብሪታንያ ፖሊስ የቀድሞ የቴሌቪዥን አቅራቢ እና የህፃናት መጽሐፍ ደራሲ በሆነው ዴቪድ ዋሊያምስ ላይ በደረሱ የወሲብ ጥቃት እና በወጣቶች ላይ የሚፈጸም አግባብ ያልሆነ ድርጊት ክስ ምርመራ መጀመሩን አስታውቋል። የቅርብ ጊዜ ዘገባዎች እንደሚያመለክቱት፣ ተከሳሹ ከ2003 ዓ.ም ጀምሮ በበርካታ ወጣት ሴቶች ላይ ወሲባዊ ጥቃት እንደፈጸመ ተነግሯል። ዋሊያምስ ክሱን ሙሉ በሙሉ ውድቅ ያደረገ ሲሆን፣ ምንም አይነት ህገወጥ ድርጊት እንዳልፈጸመ ተናግሯል። ይህንን ተከትሎ የደራሲው አሳታሚ ድርጅት እና ወኪል ስራቸውን ሲያቋርጡ፣ ቢቢሲም የእርሱን ፕሮግራሞች ከስርጭት ውጭ አድርጓል።
oromo: Poolisiin biyya Ingiliz nama beekamaa fi barreessaa ta'e Deevid Waaliyaamsirratti himannaa yakka saalqunnamtii fi ijoollee irratti miidhaa geessise jedhamuun qorannoo eegaleera. Himannaan kun kan ibsuu, akkaataa itti inni bara 2003 irraa eegalee dubartoota dargaggootaa irratti miidhaa geessisaa ture ibsa. Waaliyaams himannaa kana guutummaatti kan haale yoo ta'u, seera kamiyyuu akka hin cabsine ibseera. Ta'us, rakkoo kana hordofee dhaabbanni maxxansaa isaa fi bakka bu'aan isaa walitti dhufeenya isaan qaban kan kutatan yoo ta'u, BBC-nis sagantaawwan isaa bakka itti tamsaasurraa kaaseera.

title: Microsoft services begin recovering after global outage
english: Microsoft has started restoring its services following a major global disruption that impacted users across over 70 countries. The outage affected critical systems such as Outlook and Teams, causing significant issues for government offices, pharmacies, and courts. The company confirmed the problem was caused by a technical overload rather than a malicious cyberattack.
amharic: በሰባ በላይ አገራት ላይ ተጽዕኖ ያሳደረው የማይክሮሶፍት ዓለም አቀፍ የአገልግሎት መስተጓጎል ወደ ነበረበት መመለስ ጀምሯል። ይህ ችግር በተለይም Outlook እና Teams አገልግሎቶችን በመጉዳቱ የመንግስት ተቋማትን፣ ፋርማሲዎችን እና ፍርድ ቤቶችን ለከፍተኛ ችግር ዳርጓል። ኩባንያው ችግሩ የተፈጠረው በቴክኒካዊ ብልሽት እንጂ በሳይበር ጥቃት አለመሆኑን አስታውቋል።
oromo: Tajaajilli Microsoft addunyaa guututti miidhamuun isaa booda amma gara idilee isaatti deebi'aa jira. Rakkoon teeknikaa kun biyyoota 70 ol keessatti Outlook fi Teams irratti dhiibbaa uumuun dhaabbilee mootummaa, qoricha manoota fi mana murtii irratti rakkoo guddaa uumee ture. Kompaaniin Microsoft rakkoon kun kan uumame dhiibbaa teeknikaatiin malee haleellaa saayibarii miti jechuun mirkaneesseera.

title: Afghanistan’s new road to China ends at a closed border
english: The Taliban government has constructed a new gravel road through the Wakhan Corridor to reach the Chinese border, aiming to boost trade and lessen economic dependence on Pakistan. However, the path currently ends at a closed frontier, as China has neither officially recognized the route nor established any customs facilities there. Despite the Afghan administration's investment in this infrastructure, the remote pass remains impassable for much of the year, and Beijing has yet to signal when or if it will open for commercial use.
amharic: የታሊባን አስተዳደር ከቻይና ጋር ያለውን የንግድ ግንኙነት ለማጠናከር እና በፓኪስታን ላይ ያለውን ጥገኝነት ለመቀነስ ታስቦ የተገነባ አዲስ የመንገድ ፕሮጀክት በዋካን ኮሪደር በኩል ማጠናቀቁን አስታውቋል። ይሁን እንጂ መንገዱ የሚያበቃው ድንበር ላይ ቢሆንም፣ የቻይና መንግስት እስካሁን ምንም አይነት የጉምሩክ አገልግሎት ባለመክፈቱ እና ድንበሩ ዝግ በመሆኑ ተጨባጭ የንግድ እንቅስቃሴ አልተጀመረም። ለብዙ ወራት በበረዶ የሚዘጋው ይህ የድንበር አካባቢ፣ የቻይናን ፍላጎት ባለማግኘቱ የታቀደው የኢኮኖሚ ትስስር አሁንም እርግጠኛ ባልሆነ ሁኔታ ውስጥ ይገኛል።
oromo: Mootummaan Taalibaan guddina daldalaa fi irkadduummaa Paakistaan irra jiru hir’isuuf jedhee karaa haaraa godaambaa Waakhaan keessatti gara daangaa Chaayinaatti geessu ijaareera. Haa ta’u malee, karaan kun daangaa cufaa irratti kan xumuramu yoo ta’u, Chaayinaan hanga ammaatti daangaa kana saaqquuf ykn iddoo gumuruka qabaachuuf fedhii hin agarsiisne. Naannoon kun ji’oota baay’ee qilleensa akkaan qorraa fi cabbiin kan cufamu waan ta’eef, karaa ijaarame kana fayyadamuun daldalaaf ammas rakkoo ta’ee jira.

title: Rubio says economic pain inflicted on Iran makes military action unnecessary
english: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio stated that direct military intervention in Iran is currently avoidable due to the effectiveness of economic sanctions in weakening the regime. He emphasized that the primary goal remains preventing Iran from ever acquiring nuclear weapons. Rubio also acknowledged that these ongoing geopolitical tensions have contributed to higher fuel prices and economic difficulties for American citizens.
amharic: የአሜሪካው የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትር ማርኮ ሩቢዮ በኢራን ላይ እየተጣለ ያለው ከባድ የኢኮኖሚ ማዕቀብ አገሪቱን ስላዳከማት፣ ወታደራዊ እርምጃ መውሰድ አያስፈልግም ብለዋል። ዋናው ግቡ ኢራን የኒውክሌር መሳሪያ እንዳታገኝ ማረጋገጥ መሆኑን የገለጹት ሚኒስትሩ፣ እነዚህ ውጥረት ነክ ሁኔታዎች በአሜሪካውያን ላይ የነዳጅ ዋጋ ጭማሪን ጨምሮ የተወሰኑ ኢኮኖሚያዊ ጫናዎችን እየፈጠሩ መሆናቸውን አምነዋል።
oromo: Ministirri Dhimma Alaa Ameerikaa Maarko Ruubiyoo, guddina diinagdee Iran irratti xiyyeeffatuun kutaaleen biyyattii waan laafaniif, waraana banuun barbaachisaa miti jedhaniiru. Kaayyoon guddaan Iran meeshaa niwukileraa akka hin qabaanne taasisuu akka ta'e ibsanii, rakkoon diinagdee kun gatii boba'aa dabaluun lammiilee Ameerikaa irratti dhiibbaa geessisaa jiraachuu isaanii beekaniiru.

title: Iran's navy claims US MQ-I drone shot down off southern coast
english: The Iranian Navy recently reported that it successfully downed an American MQ-1 Predator drone near the southern province of Hormozgan. According to official reports, the aircraft was intercepted and destroyed by a local integrated air defense system while flying near the Strait of Hormuz. The US-made drone was identified as a remotely piloted vehicle typically used by the American Air Force for surveillance missions.
amharic: የኢራን የባህር ኃይል በአገሪቱ ደቡባዊ ክፍል በሚገኘው ሆርሞዝጋን ግዛት አቅራቢያ የአሜሪካን MQ-1 ድሮን መትቶ መጣሉን አስታውቋል። በይፋዊ መግለጫው መሰረት፣ ድሮኑ በሆርሙዝ ባህር ሰላጤ አቅራቢያ ሲበር በአካባቢው በተዘረጋው የተቀናጀ የአየር መከላከያ ስርዓት ተጠልፎ እንዲወድም ተደርጓል። በአሜሪካ የአየር ኃይል የሚጠቀመው ይህ ሰው አልባ አውሮፕላን በክትትል ስራዎች ላይ የሚውል መሆኑም ተገልጿል።
oromo: Humnooni galaanaa Iraan, xiyyaara nama hin feene (drone) kan Ameerikaa kan MQ-1 jedhamu kutaa biyyattii kibbaatti, naannoo Hormozganitti akka kuffisan ibsan. Gabaasawwan akka agarsiisanitti, xiyyaarri kun Hormuz Strait bira osoo balali'uutti jiruu, sirna ittisa qilleensaa biyyattii tiin dhaqabee akka kufuu ta'eera. Xiyyaarri nama hin feene kun kan Ameerikaan hojii qorannoo fi hordoffii tiif itti fayyadamtuu dha.

title: Iran warns of 'immediate response' to any US-Israeli attack, slams Gulf nations
english: Iran has issued a strong warning that any new military strikes from the U.S. or Israel against its territory will be met with a swift and forceful retaliation. During a UN Security Council meeting, Iranian officials specifically accused neighboring Gulf states, particularly Bahrain, of enabling these attacks by providing military support and access. In response, Bahrain dismissed these claims and criticized Iran for attempting to justify regional aggression under the guise of self-defense.
amharic: ኢራን በአገሯ ላይ ከዩናይትድ ስቴትስ ወይም ከእስራኤል የሚሰነዘር ማንኛውም ጥቃት ወዲያውኑ አጸፋዊ ምላሽ እንደሚሰጥ አስጠንቅቃለች። በተባበሩት መንግስታት የጸጥታው ምክር ቤት ስብሰባ ላይ የኢራን ዲፕሎማቶች የባህረ ሰላጤው አገራት በተለይም ባህሬን ወታደራዊ መሠረተ ልማቶቻቸውን በመጠቀም ጥቃቱን እያመቻቹ እንደሆነ ከሰዋል። በበኩሏ ባህሬን ይህንን ክስ ውድቅ በማድረግ ኢራን በጎረቤት አገራት ላይ የምታደርሰውን ጥቃት ለራሷ የመከላከል መብት በማለት ማቅረቧን ተችታለች።
oromo: Iraan, yoo weerarri haaraa Ameerikaa ykn Israa'el irraa biyyattii irratti gaggeeffame deebii saffisaa fi cimaa kan kennitu ta'uu akeekkachiisteetti. Walgahii Mana Maree Nageenyaa UN irratti, jilaan Iraan biyyoonni naannoo Goolfii, keessattuu Baahireen, weerara kanaaf mijaa'ina uumanii fi buufata waraanaa isaanii fayyadamanii akka turan himatteetti. Baahireen himata kana kan mormite yoo ta'u, Iraan weerara biyyoota ollaa irratti raawwattu 'of-ittisuu' jechuun ishee sirrii miti jetteetti.

title: UN, partners urge Israel to lift restrictions on aid into Gaza
english: The United Nations and various humanitarian groups are calling on Israel to remove obstacles preventing aid from reaching Gaza, citing that recent severe rainstorms have caused tragic deaths and destroyed essential shelters. Despite having thousands of tents ready for distribution, aid agencies have been unable to implement their winter survival plans due to ongoing supply restrictions and a lack of funding. Humanitarian leaders are urging the international community to intervene and push for better access so that urgent life-saving support and infrastructure repairs can finally proceed.
amharic: የተባበሩት መንግስታት ድርጅት እና ሌሎች የሰብአዊ ድርጅቶች እስራኤል ወደ ጋዛ የሚላከውን እርዳታ ላይ የጣለችውን እገዳ እንድታነሳ እየጠየቁ ነው። በቅርቡ የጣለው ከባድ ዝናብ ለሞት እና ለተጠለሉበት መጠለያ መውደም ምክንያት መሆኑን በመጥቀስ፣ የእርዳታ አቅርቦት እጥረቱ ሁኔታውን እንዳባባሰው አስታውቀዋል። በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ድንኳኖች ዝግጁ ቢሆኑም፣ በእገዳዎች እና በገንዘብ እጥረት ምክንያት እርዳታው ለተጎጂዎች መድረስ አልቻለም። ዓለም አቀፉ ማህበረሰብም ችግሩን ለመፍታት እና አስፈላጊውን የገንዘብ ድጋፍ ለማድረግ ጣልቃ እንዲገባ ጥሪ ቀርቧል።
oromo: Dhaabbanni Mootummoota Gamtoomanii fi dhaabbileen gargaarsa namoomaa biroo, Israa'el gargaarsa gara Gaazaatti ergamu irratti daangaa kaa'ite akka kaastu gaafachaa jiru. Roobni cimaan dhiheenya kana roobe lubbuu namaa galaafachuu fi godoo baqattootaa mancaasuu isaa eeruun, hanqinni dhiyeessii rakkoo kana daran hammaachiiseera. Gadoo fi meeshaaleen gargaarsaa kumaan lakkaa'aman qophaa'aa ta'us, dhorkaa fi rakkoo maallaqaa irraa kan ka'e gargaarsi kun yeroo isaa eeggatee akka hin geenye ta'eera. Hawaasni idil-addunyaas rakkoo kana furuuf dhiibbaa gochuu fi deeggarsa barbaachisu akka godhu waamichi dhiyaateera.

title: Centcom says two Iranian drones aimed at Bahrain shot down
english: The U.S. Central Command successfully intercepted and destroyed two explosive drones sent by the Iranian Revolutionary Guard toward Bahrain. While Iran claimed to have struck a U.S. radar facility, military officials denied this report, confirming that the attack caused no casualties or property damage. The incident highlights ongoing tensions between the two nations in the region.
amharic: የአሜሪካ ሴንትኮም ወደ ባህሬን በኢራን አብዮታዊ ዘበኛ የተላኩ ሁለት የጥቃት ድሮኖችን መትቶ መጣሉን አስታውቋል። ኢራን በአሜሪካ የራዳር ጣቢያ ላይ ጥቃት ማድረሷን ብትናገርም፣ የአሜሪካ ወታደራዊ አመራር ይህንን ሀሰት በማለት ጥቃቱ ምንም አይነት ጉዳት እንዳልደረሰ አረጋግጧል። ይህ ክስተት በሁለቱ ሀገራት መካከል ያለውን ውጥረት የሚያሳይ ነው።
oromo: Ajajni giddu galeessa waraana Ameerikaa (Centcom) xiyyoorrattiiwwan ofiin of ajjeesan lama kanneen humnoota Iran irraa gara Baahireynitti ergamanii turan rukutamee akka kuffifaman beeksisera. Iran raadaara Ameerikaa rukutuu ishee kan himatte ta'us, qondaaltonni waraana Ameerikaa oduun kun dhara ta'uu fi miidhaan lubbuus ta'e qabeenyaa irra hin geenyee jedhaniiru. Gochi kun walitti bu'iinsa biyyoota lamaan gidduu jiru kan agarsiisu dha.

title: Microsoft 'deeply sorry' for global outage after almost 24 hours of disruption
english: Microsoft has apologized for a major global technical glitch that disrupted services like Outlook and Teams for nearly a full day. The outage, which was caused by a network upgrade rather than a cyberattack, affected millions of users across more than 70 countries, including hospitals, government agencies, and transportation systems. Although services began to recover by Friday afternoon, the incident highlighted how vulnerable critical infrastructure is to failures at large technology companies.
amharic: ማይክሮሶፍት በዓለም ዙሪያ ለቀን ሙሉ ለተስተጓጎለው የኦውትሉክ እና የቲምስ አገልግሎት መቋረጥ ይቅርታ ጠይቋል። ችግሩ የደረሰው በሳይበር ጥቃት ሳይሆን በኔትወርክ ማሻሻያ ወቅት በተፈጠረ ቴክኒካዊ ግድፈት መሆኑ ተገልጿል። ይህ መቆራረጥ ከ70 በላይ አገራት ውስጥ በሆስፒታሎች፣ በመንግሥት ተቋማት እና በትራንስፖርት አገልግሎቶች ላይ ከፍተኛ ተጽዕኖ አሳድሯል።
oromo: Microsoft tajaajilli isaa kanneen akka Outlook fi Teams guyyaa guutuu adda cituusaatiif gadi jabeessee dhiifama gaafateera. Rakkinichi kan uumame ergaa sirna interneetii fooyyessuuf yaalamte irratti dogoggora tekinikaa uumameen malee haleellaa hakerootaan miti. Hanqinni kun biyyoota 70 ol keessatti dhaabbilee fayyaa, kan mootummaa fi tajaajila geejjibaarratti dhiibbaa guddaa geessiseera.

title: Rosenberg: Uncompromising Putin ups demands for peace with Ukraine
english: Russian President Vladimir Putin is reiterating strict demands for peace that effectively seek to reshape Europe’s security landscape. Moscow is reviving controversial proposals from 2021, which include blocking Ukraine from joining NATO and withdrawing Western military infrastructure from Eastern Europe. By bringing these demands back to the negotiating table, Russia aims to force the West to address its concerns regarding the expansion of the alliance.
amharic: የሩሲያው ፕሬዝዳንት ቭላዲሚር ፑቲን የአውሮፓን የፀጥታ መዋቅር በአዲስ መልክ የሚቀርጽ የሰላም ስምምነት እንዲኖር ጥብቅ ቅድመ ሁኔታዎችን አቅርበዋል። ሞስኮ ከ2021 ጀምሮ የነበሩ አወዛጋቢ የሆኑ ጥያቄዎቿን እንደገና በማንሳት ዩክሬን የኔቶ አባል እንዳትሆን እና የኔቶ ወታደራዊ መሠረተ ልማቶች ከምስራቅ አውሮፓ እንዲወጡ እየጠየቀች ነው። በእነዚህ ጥያቄዎች አማካኝነት ሩሲያ በኔቶ መስፋፋት ላይ ያላትን ተቃውሞ ምዕራባውያን እንዲቀበሉ ለማስገደድ እየሞከረች ነው።
oromo: Pireezidaantiin Raashiyaa Vulaadimiir Puutin, akkaataa nageenyi Awurooppaa itti caaseffamu jijjiiruu danda'u irratti gaaffilee cimaa kaasaa jiru. Moskoon yaada mormii kaasee ture kan bara 2021 deebistee kaasuun, Yuukireen miseensa Neetoo akka hin taaneefii buuuraaleen waraana Neetoo biyyoota Awurooppaa bahaa keessaa akka bahuu qaban gaafachaa jirti. Raashiyaan tarkaanfiin kun, biyyoonni lixaa bal'ina Neetoo irratti yaaddoo isheen qabdu akka dhaggeeffatan dirqisiisuu akka ta'e yaaddeetti.

title: Nvidia scandal fallout widens as Trump's treasury secretary blames cabinet colleague
english: A political controversy is intensifying following the removal of Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang due to his involvement with a suspected Chinese spy. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent has publicly criticized Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick for failing to restrict the export of advanced AI chips to a firm linked to that spy. Consequently, Lutnick is now facing intense congressional scrutiny and demands to explain why his department did not effectively prevent these sensitive technologies from reaching China.
amharic: የኤንቪዲያ (Nvidia) ዋና ሥራ አስፈፃሚ ጄንሰን ሁዋንግ ከቻይና ሰላይ ጋር ግንኙነት ነበራቸው በሚል ከኃላፊነታቸው መነሳታቸውን ተከትሎ የፖለቲካ ውዝግቡ እየተባባሰ ነው። የአሜሪካ የገንዘብ ሚኒስትሩ ስኮት ቤሰንት፣ የንግድ ሚኒስትሩ ሆዋርድ ሉትኒክ ለዚህ ሰላይ ጋር ግንኙነት ባለው ድርጅት በኩል የላቁ የቴክኖሎጂ ቺፖች ወደ ቻይና እንዳይገቡ መቆጣጠር አልቻሉም ሲሉ ወቅሰዋል። በዚህም ምክንያት ሉትኒክ የንግድ ሚኒስቴር ለምን እንደዘገየ ለማስረዳት በሴኔት ፊት እንዲቀርቡ ከፍተኛ ጫና እየተደረገባቸው ነው።
oromo: Hogganaan olaanaan dhaabbata Nvidia, Jensen Huang, basaastuu Chaayinaa waliin walitti dhufeenya qabaachuun isaanii erga ifoomee booda rakkoon kun bal'achaa jira. Ministirri Maallaqa Amerikaa Scott Bessent, Ministirri Daldalaa Howard Lutnick chipiiwwan teeknoolojii ammayyaa gara Chaayinaatti akka hin ceene to'achuu dhabuun isaanii dogoggora akka ta'e dubbatan. Kana hordofuus, Lutnick gochi kun maaliif akka raawwatameefi maaliif akka hin to'atamne ibsuuf dhiibbaa seeraa fi siyaasaa cimaa keessa jiru.

title: LIVE: FAA issues nationwide ground stop after communications outage in US
english: The U.S. Federal Aviation Administration has ordered a nationwide ground stop for all departing flights due to a technical failure in communication systems. Aviation authorities are currently working to identify and resolve the issue affecting air traffic control. Passengers are advised to expect significant delays while technical teams investigate the cause of the outage.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የፌደራል አቪዬሽን አስተዳደር የመገናኛ ዘዴዎች በመስተጓጎላቸው ምክንያት በሀገሪቱ የሚገኙ በረራዎችን በሙሉ አግዷል። የቴክኒክ ባለሙያዎች የአየር ትራፊክ ቁጥጥር ማማዎችን የገጠመውን ችግር ለመፍታት ጥረት እያደረጉ ነው። በዚህ ችግር ምክንያት በረራዎች ከፍተኛ መስተጓጎል እንደሚገጥማቸው ተገልጿል።
oromo: Bulchiinsi Birmadummaa Qilleensa US (FAA) rakkoo qunnamtii tekinikaa uumameen walqabatee, balaliiwwan biyyattii keessatti godhaman hunda yeroof dhaabeera. Ogeeyyiin tekinikaa rakkoo tajaajila to'annoo balalii irratti mudate furuuf hojjechaa jiru. Rakkoo kana hordofee balaliiwwan hedduun akka harkifatan beekameera.

title: US grounds all flights after ‘communication issue’
english: The United States has implemented a nationwide ground stop for all flights due to a significant technical failure in air traffic control communication systems. Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy confirmed that FAA technicians are working to resolve the issue, which has already caused thousands of cancellations and delays. This incident highlights ongoing difficulties with the country's aging aviation infrastructure as authorities seek additional funding for modernization.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የትራንስፖርት መምሪያ በአየር ትራፊክ ቁጥጥር ሥርዓት ውስጥ ባጋጠመ የቴክኒክ ችግር ምክንያት በመላ አገሪቱ የሚደረጉ በረራዎችን በሙሉ ማቋረጡን አስታውቋል። የትራንስፖርት ሚኒስትሩ ሾን ዳፊ ጉዳዩን ለመፍታት የፌዴራል አቪዬሽን አስተዳደር ባለሙያዎች እየሰሩ መሆናቸውን ገልጸዋል። ይህ ችግር በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ በረራዎች እንዲሰረዙ እና እንዲዘገዩ ያደረገ ሲሆን፣ በአገሪቱ የድሮ የአቪዬሽን መሰረተ ልማት ማሻሻያ አስፈላጊነትን አጉልቶ አሳይቷል።
oromo: Amerikaa keessatti rakkoo quunnamtii sirna to’annoo balaliin walqabateen balaliin xiyyaaraa biyyoolessaa hundi akka dhaabbatu ta’eera. Ministirri Geejjibaa biyyattii ሾን ዳፊ akka ibsanitti, ogeeyyiin bulchiinsa balaliin federaalaa rakkoo kana furuuf hojjechaa jiru. Rakkoon kun balalii kumaan lakkaa’amu akka haqu ykn tursiisu taasiseera; kunis bu’uuraaleealee geejjiba qilleensaa biyyattii kan duraanii fooyyessuuf maallaqa dabalataa akka barbaachisu kan mul’isuudha.

title: Pope Leo cheered on return to Peru city where he served as bishop
english: Pope Leo XIV received a warm welcome from approximately 1.5 million people during his visit to the Peruvian city of Chiclayo, where he previously worked as a bishop. This trip marks his return to the region shortly after recovering from a surgical procedure for lung cancer. During the event, the Pope held an open-air Mass to address the large crowd of supporters.
amharic: ርዕሰ ሊቃነ ጳጳሳት ሊዮ አሥራ አራተኛ በፔሩ ቺክላዮ ከተማ በቆዩበት ወቅት በአንድ ሚሊዮን ተኩል የሚጠጉ ምዕመናን ደማቅ አቀባበል አድርገውላቸዋል። በከተማዋ የቀድሞ የጳጳስነት አገልግሎት የነበራቸው ርዕሰ ሊቃነ ጳጳሳቱ፣ ለሳንባ ካንሰር ህክምና ከተደረገላቸው ቀዶ ጥገና በኋላ ወደ ስራቸው ተመልሰዋል። ጉብኝታቸውንም ተከትሎ ለተሰበሰበው ህዝብ የውጭ ሜዳ ላይ ቅዳሴ አስቀድሰዋል።
oromo: Pappaan Leo XIV magaalaa Peeruu kan taate Chiclayo yeroo deebi'anitti, namoonni miliyoona 1.5 ta'an simannaa ho'aa ta'e godhaniifii jiru. Magaalattii kanaan dura biishophummaan kan tajaajilan isaan, opireeshinii kansaara sombaatiin erga yaalamanii booda deebi'anii daawwannaa taasisaa jiru. Daawwannaa isaanii kanaanis bakka namoonni baay'een jiranitti guyyaa kabajaa (Mass) geggeessaniiru.

title: Qatar and Turkiye send message of deterrence with new defence pact
english: Qatar and Turkiye have finalized a new mutual defense agreement to strengthen their security ties during a period of rising regional tensions. Analysts suggest this partnership is primarily intended to act as a strategic deterrent against potential threats. The pact signifies a deeper military and political alliance between the two nations.
amharic: ኳታር እና ቱርክ በአካባቢው እየጨመረ የመጣውን አለመረጋጋት ለመቋቋም የሚያስችል የጋራ የመከላከያ ስምምነት ተፈራርመዋል። የዚህ ስምምነት ዋና ዓላማ ለወደፊት ሊከሰቱ የሚችሉ ችግሮችን በመከላከል ረገድ ስትራቴጂያዊ ሚና መጫወት እንደሆነ ባለሙያዎች ይናገራሉ። ይህ ስምምነት በሁለቱ ሀገራት መካከል ያለውን የጸጥታና የወታደራዊ ግንኙነት ይበልጥ ያጠናክራል ተብሎ ይጠበቃል።
oromo: Qatar fi Turkin yeroo ammaa naannichatti rakkooleen nageenyaa dabalaa dhufaa jiran furuuf walii galtee ittisaa waliinii mallatteessaniiru. Ogeeyyiin akka jedhanitti, walii galteen kun walitti bu’iinsa yeruma sanaa qolachuu irra, tarsiimoon of ittisuu irratti kan xiyyeeffate dha. Walii galteen kun hariiroo waraanaa fi siyaasaa biyyoota lamaan gidduu jiru kan cimsu ta'uu himameera.

title: Australia captain Cummins denies involvement in ‘Sandpapergate’
english: Australian cricket captain Pat Cummins has officially dismissed claims made by his former teammate Usman Khawaja regarding the 2018 ball-tampering scandal. Khawaja suggested in his new book that Cummins was involved in the incident, but Cummins denies any participation. The captain expressed his disappointment and feeling of betrayal following these public accusations.
amharic: የአውስትራሊያ የክሪኬት ቡድን ካፒቴን ፓት ካሚንስ በ2018 ስለተፈጠረው የኳስ ማጭበርበር ቅሌት የቀድሞ የቡድን አጋሩ ዑስማን ካዋጃ ያቀረቡትን ክስ አስተባበሉ። ካዋጃ በአዲሱ መጽሐፋቸው ካሚንስ በጉዳዩ ላይ እጃቸው እንዳለበት ቢገልጹም፣ ካሚንስ ግን በምንም መልኩ እንዳልተሳተፉ ገልጸዋል። ካፒቴኑ በእነዚህ የይገባኛል ጥያቄዎች የተሰማውን ቅር እና የክህደት ስሜት በግልጽ ተናግረዋል።
oromo: Kabtaan garee kirikeetii Awustiraaliyaa Paat Kaamins, himata hiriyoota isaa duraanii Usmaan Kaawaajaan waggaa 2018 irratti waa'ee malaammaltummaa kubbaa irratti dhiyeessan haaleera. Kaawaajaan kitaaba isaanii haaraa keessatti Kaamins gocha kana keessatti hirmaachuu isaanii eeranis, Kaamins garuu gocha kana keessatti hirmaannaa tokkollee akka hin qabne ibsaniiru. Kabtichi himata kana booda miira gumaa fi aarii akka itti dhaga'ame ibseera.

title: Why is the Microsoft outage lasting so long?
english: A widespread Microsoft 365 outage has disrupted essential services for schools, governments, and businesses globally by causing issues with Outlook, Teams, and AI tools. Microsoft confirmed the problem stems from connectivity failures rather than a cyberattack and is working to restore full functionality. Users may continue to experience delays with emails, as the company has extended delivery windows to help recover messages.
amharic: በአለም አቀፍ ደረጃ የተከሰተው የMicrosoft 365 መቆራረጥ በትምህርት ቤቶች፣ በመንግስት ተቋማት እና በንግድ ድርጅቶች አገልግሎት ላይ ከፍተኛ ተጽዕኖ ፈጥሯል። ማይክሮሶፍት ችግሩ የሳይበር ጥቃት ሳይሆን የቴክኒክ የግንኙነት መቋረጥ መሆኑን ገልጾ፣ አገልግሎቶችን ወደነበሩበት ለመመለስ ጥረት እያደረገ ነው። ተጠቃሚዎች የኢሜይል መዘግየቶችን ሊያጋጥሟቸው እንደሚችሉና ኩባንያው መልዕክቶች እንዲደርሱ የማድረስ ስራ እየሰራ መሆኑን አስታውቋል።
oromo: Rakkoon tekinoolojii Microsoft 365 irratti mudate kun addunyaa guututti manneen barnootaa, mootummaa fi dhaabbilee daldalaa irratti dhiibbaa uumeera. Microsoft rakkoon kun kan dhufe humni qilleensaa (cyberattack) osoo hin taane, hanqina walitti hidhamiinsa interneetii irraa akka ta'e ibseera. Tajaajilli guututti akka deebi'uuf hojjechaa kan jiran yoo ta'u, ergaaleen imeelii akka turan waan danda'uuf, Microsoft yeroo dheereessuun ergaawwan akka qaqqaban tattaaffii gochaa jira.

title: Watch: How a server outage took down Microsoft Teams and Outlook
english: A technical failure has disrupted major Microsoft services, including Outlook, Teams, and Copilot. The company identified that excessive pressure on its servers triggered the outage. Microsoft is currently working to resolve the issue and reports that their systems are beginning to stabilize.
amharic: የቴክኒክ ችግር የማይክሮሶፍት ዋና ዋና አገልግሎቶች የሆኑትን አውትሉክን፣ ቲምስን እና ኮፓይለትን አስተጓጉሏል። ኩባንያው ችግሩ የተፈጠረው በአገልጋዮቹ ላይ በደረሰ ከፍተኛ ጫና ምክንያት መሆኑን ገልጿል። ማይክሮሶፍት ችግሩን ለመፍታት እየሰራ ሲሆን ስርዓቶቹ ወደ መደበኛ ሁኔታ መመለስ መጀመራቸውን አስታውቋል።
oromo: Rakkoon teeknikaa tajaajiloota gurguddoo kanneen akka Microsoft Outlook, Teams fi Copilot irratti addaan cituu fidee jira. Dhaabbatichi rakkoon kun kan uumame dhiibbaa seervaroota isaanii irratti taasifameen akka ta'e beeksiseera. Microsoft amma rakkoo kana furuuf hojjechaa kan jiru yoo ta'u, sirnoonni isaanii gara haala isaanii duriitti deebi'uuf mallattoolee jalqabaa argisiisaa jiraachuu ibseera.

title: UN watchdog 'increasingly concerned' over uninspected Iran nuclear site
english: The International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA) has expressed growing alarm over an uninspected uranium enrichment facility in Isfahan, Iran, established just before military strikes occurred last year. Inspectors are currently unable to confirm the site's status or the safety of Iran’s nuclear materials due to restricted access. Because Iran has exceeded its previous enrichment limits and failed to provide transparency, the UN watchdog is urging immediate cooperation to address global proliferation concerns.
amharic: የተባበሩት መንግስታት የኑክሌር ተቆጣጣሪ ኤጀንሲ (IAEA) ኢራን ኢስፋሃን ከተማ ውስጥ ያቋቋመችውን እና እስካሁን ፍተሻ ያልተደረገበትን የኑክሌር ማዕከል አስመልክቶ ከፍተኛ ስጋት እንዳለው ገልጿል። ኢራን ቁጥጥርን በመገደቧ ኤጀንሲው በጣቢያው የሚገኘውን የኑክሌር ቁሳቁስ ሁኔታ ማረጋገጥ አልቻለም። ኢራን ከዚህ ቀደም የነበራትን የዩራኒየም ማበልጸጊያ ገደብ በመጣሷ እና ግልጽነት በማጣቷ፣ አለም አቀፍ ስጋትን ለመከላከል ኤጀንሲው በአስቸኳይ ትብብር እንዲደረግላቸው ጠይቋል።
oromo: Dhaabbanni hordoffii niukleerii kan UN (IAEA) magaalaa Isfahaan keessatti dhaabbata niukleerii kan hin qoratamne ilaalchisee yaaddoo cimaa qabaachuusaa ibseera. Iiraan qorattootaaf hayyama dhoorkachuu isheetiin kan ka'e, dhaabbatichi meeshaalee niukleerii achi keessa jiran sirritti mirkaneeffachuu hin dandeenye. Iiraan daangaa niukleerii kanaan dura taa'e darbuu fi iftoomina dhabuu isheetiin, dhaabbatichi yaaddoo nageenyaa addunyaa kana furuuf battalumatti hojiin hordoffii akka gaggeeffamu gaafateera.

title: US Treasury warns against rate hikes during US-Iran war energy ‘shock’
english: US Treasury warns against rate hikes during US-Iran war energy ‘shock’

title: Truck and bus crash in India’s Assam state kills at least 24 people
english: A tragic collision between a bus and a truck in India’s Assam state has resulted in at least 24 deaths, including several children and the driver. Eleven people were also injured in the incident, which occurred near Kaziranga National Park, and authorities warn that the casualty count may increase. Emergency teams are currently providing medical assistance to survivors while local officials express deep condolences to the affected families.
amharic: በህንድ የአሳም ግዛት ውስጥ በአውቶቡስ እና በጭነት መኪና መካከል በተከሰተው አደጋ የበርካታ ህጻናትን እና የአውቶቡስ ሹፌሩን ጨምሮ ቢያንስ 24 ሰዎች ህይወታቸው አልፏል። በአደጋው ሌሎች 11 ሰዎች የቆሰሉ ሲሆን፣ የካዚራንጋ ብሔራዊ ፓርክ አቅራቢያ በተፈጠረው በዚህ አሳዛኝ ክስተት የሟቾች ቁጥር ሊጨምር እንደሚችል ባለስልጣናት ስጋታቸውን ገልጸዋል። የአካባቢው አስተዳደር የተጎዱትን ሰዎች ለመርዳት አስፈላጊውን የህክምና ድጋፍ እያደረገ ሲሆን፣ ለሟቾች ቤተሰቦችም ጥልቅ ሀዘናቸውን ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Indiyaa keessatti, naannoo Assamitti konkolaataa busii fi konkolaataa fe'umsaa walitti bu'uun lubbuun namoota 24 ol darbeera; kanneen du'an keessaa ijoollee fi ogeessi konkolaachisaan ni argamu. Balaa kana keessatti namoonni 11 miidhamaniiru, akkasumas lafa biyyoolessaa Kaaziraangaa biratti waan ta'eef, lakkoofsi namoota du'anii dabaluu akka danda'u ibsameera. Mootummaan naannichaa miidhamtootaaf gargaarsa fayyaa ariifachiisaa taasisaa jiru yoo ta'u, maatii miidhamtootaafis gadda cimaa ibseera.

title: Turkiye and Qatar sign mutual defence agreement
english: Turkiye and Qatar have finalized a mutual defense agreement following a high-level meeting between President Erdogan and the Emir of Qatar in Istanbul. The deal aims to strengthen bilateral military ties and foster regional stability amid growing security concerns in the Gulf. Experts suggest the pact may lead to the deployment of advanced Turkish air defense systems to protect Qatari territory.
amharic: ቱርክ እና ኳታር በፕሬዝዳንት ኤርዶጋን እና በኳታር አሚር መካከል በኢስታንቡል በተደረገው ከፍተኛ ደረጃ ውይይት ተከትሎ የጋራ መከላከያ ስምምነት ተፈራርመዋል። ስምምነቱ በሁለቱ አገራት መካከል ያለውን ወታደራዊ ግንኙነት ለማጠናከር እና በባህረ ሰላጤው አካባቢ እየተባባሰ የመጣውን የጸጥታ ስጋት ለመከላከል ያለመ ነው። ባለሙያዎች ይህ ስምምነት የኳታርን ደህንነት ለመጠበቅ የቱርክን ዘመናዊ የአየር መከላከያ መሳሪያዎች ወደ አገሪቱ ለማስገባት መንገድ እንደሚከፍት ይናገራሉ።
oromo: Turkii fi Qatar marii sadarkaa olaanaa Pirezidant Erdoogan fi Amiira Qatar gidduutti Istanbulitti gaggeeffameen booda waliigaltee ittisaa waloo mallatteessaniiru. Waliigaltichi hariiroo waraanaa biyyoota lamaanii cimsuufi naannoo Goolfii keessatti yaaddoo nageenyaa dabalaa jiru hir’isuuf kan gumaachuudha. Ogeeyyonni akka jedhanitti, waliigaltee kana hordofee Turkey meeshaalee ittisa qilleensaa ammayyaa Qataritti bobbaasuuf carraa argachuu dandeessi.

title: Europe seeks seat at Ukraine peace talks but lacks unified voice
english: European Union leaders are currently debating how to secure a seat at future Russia-Ukraine peace talks to ensure the continent has a say in its own security. There is significant concern that ongoing negotiations led by the United States and Russia might sideline European interests, but the EU currently lacks a unified strategy on who should represent them. While Europe is pushing for inclusion, Russia remains opposed, arguing that European nations are too involved in supplying Ukraine's military effort to act as neutral participants.
amharic: የአውሮፓ ህብረት መሪዎች በሩሲያ እና በዩክሬን መካከል በሚደረጉ የሰላም ድርድር ላይ የራሳቸውን ድምፅ ለማሰማትና ተሳትፎ ለማድረግ እየተወያዩ ነው። አሜሪካ እና ሩሲያ የሚያደርጉት ድርድር የአውሮፓን ጥቅምና ደህንነት ችላ ይላል የሚል ስጋት ስላለ፣ ህብረቱ በዚህ ሂደት ውስጥ መካተት እንዳለበት ያምናል። ይሁን እንጂ የአውሮፓ ህብረት የትኛው አካል እንደሚወክላቸው እስካሁን መስማማት አልቻሉም። በሌላ በኩል ሩሲያ የአውሮፓ ሀገራት ለዩክሬን ወታደራዊ ድጋፍ በመስጠታቸው ገለልተኛ አይደሉም በማለት ተሳትፎአቸውን እንደምትቃወም ገልጻለች።
oromo: Goggoonni gamtaa Awurooppaa marii nageenyaa Rashiyaafi Yukreen gidduutti gaggeeffamu irratti sagalee mataa isaanii qabaachuufi hirmaachuu danda'an irratti mari'achaa jiru. Mariin Ameerikaafi Rashiyaatti hogganamu sun faayidaa Awurooppaa bakka bu'uu danda'a waan jedhaniif, gamtichi hirmaannaa barbaada. Haa ta'u malee, gamtichi eenyuun bakka buufachuu akka qaban irratti waliigalteerra hin geenye. Gama biraatiin, Rashiyaan biyyoonni Awurooppaa meeshaa waraanaa Yukreeniif dhiyeessuun garee waraanaa ta'anii waan jiraniif, marii kana keessatti hirmaachuu akka hin qabne mormaa jirti.

title: Will Democrats try to strip US-Israel initiative from Pentagon funding?
english: Following their recent midterm election successes, Democrats are considering removing a controversial provision from the Pentagon's budget that would merge U.S. and Israeli military production industries. Party leaders have previously opposed this massive defense spending package due to concerns over its high costs and the ongoing conflict with Iran. Lawmakers must now decide whether to challenge this specific initiative before the mid-December deadline when current government funding expires.
amharic: በቅርቡ በተደረገው መካከለኛ ምርጫ ባገኙት ድል፣ ዲሞክራቶች የአሜሪካን እና የእስራኤልን ወታደራዊ ኢንዱስትሪዎች የሚያዋህድ አወዛጋቢ አንቀጽ ከፔንታጎን በጀት ለማስወገድ እየመከሩ ነው። የፓርቲው መሪዎች ቀደም ሲል ለዚህ ግዙፍ የመከላከያ ወጪ ፓኬጅ የተቃውሟቸውን የገለጹት በኢራን ግጭት እና በሀገር ውስጥ ኢኮኖሚ ጉዳዮች ምክንያት ነው። የሀገሪቱ የገንዘብ ድጋፍ የሚያበቃበት የዲሴምበር አጋማሽ ቀነ ገደብ ከመድረሱ በፊት፣ አባላቱ ይህንን ልዩ ስምምነት የመቀየር ወይም ያለመቀየር ውሳኔ ላይ መድረስ ይጠበቅባቸዋል።
oromo: Bu'aa filannoo giddu-galeessaa kanaan dura argataniin, gareen Dimokiraatotaa walitti hidhiinsa indaastirii waraanaa Ameerikaa fi Israa'el kan cimsu qajeelfama mormii guddaa kaase kun baajata Pentaagoonii keessaa akka ba'uuf yaadaa jiru. Hoggantoonni paartichaa baajata waraanaa kana irratti mormii kan qaban baasii guddaa fi waraana Iiraan waliin jiruun walqabatee dha. Yeroo baajata mootummaa kan amma jiru dhumuuf ji'a Muddeetti guyyaan gahuu isaa dura, miseensonni kun bu'uura waraanaa kana irratti jijjiirama gochuu fi dhiisuu isaanii irratti murteessuun irra jira.

title: Zelensky welcomes US bringing Europe into Russia-Ukraine peace talks
english: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky has expressed support for a US-backed initiative to include European Union representatives in future peace negotiations with Russia. US envoys Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff confirmed that Moscow is willing to allow European participation following recent diplomatic meetings in both Russia and Ireland. Meanwhile, both nations have agreed to a significant prisoner exchange, marking a potential step forward amid ongoing efforts to resolve the conflict.
amharic: የዩክሬኑ ፕሬዝዳንት ቮሎዲሚር ዘለንስኪ ከአሜሪካ የቀረበውን የአውሮፓ ህብረት ተወካዮች በሩሲያ-ዩክሬን የሰላም ንግግሮች ውስጥ እንዲካተቱ የማድረግ ሀሳብ በደስታ ተቀብለዋል። የአሜሪካ መልዕክተኞች የሆኑት ጃሬድ ኩሽነር እና ስቲቭ ዊትኮፍ፣ ሞስኮ በአውሮፓ ህብረት ተሳትፎ ለመስማማት ፈቃደኛ መሆኗን ገልጸዋል። በሌላ በኩል፣ ሁለቱ ሀገራት እስረኞችን ለመለዋወጥ ከስምምነት ላይ የደረሱ ሲሆን ይህም በጦርነቱ መፍትሄ ፍለጋ ሂደት ውስጥ እንደ አንድ ተስፋ ሰጪ እርምጃ ታይቷል።
oromo: Pirezedantiin Yukreen Volodimir Zeelenski, gamtaan Awurooppaa marii nagaa Yukreen fi Raashiyaa keessatti hirmaachuu akka danda'u yaada Ameerikaan dhiheessite fudhataniiru. Ergamtoonni Ameerikaa Jaared Kushnar fi Istiiv Wiitkoof, Raashiyaan hirmaannaa Awurooppaa irratti waliigaluuf fedhii akka qabdu ibsaniiru. Gama biraan, biyyoonni lamaan paartiiwwan gidduutti waljijjiirraa hidhattootaa guddicha ta'e irratti walii galaniiru; kunis rakkoo sana hiikuuf yaalii godhamu keessatti tarkaanfii gaarii ta'uu danda'a.

title: North Korean hackers used fake video calls in $400m crypto hack, says FBI
english: The FBI reports that North Korean state-sponsored hackers have stolen $400 million in cryptocurrency by deceiving over 900 victims through fake video calls. Using malicious software disguised as audio repair tools, the attackers gain unauthorized access to devices and use recorded footage to trick new targets. This operation, known as FaceStealer, specifically targets professionals in the tech and crypto industries to fund prohibited weapons programs.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የፌዴራል ምርመራ ቢሮ (FBI) እንዳስታወቀው፣ ከሰሜን ኮሪያ በመጡ የሳይበር ጥቃት አድራሻዎች ከ900 በላይ ሰዎችን በማታለል ከ400 ሚሊዮን ዶላር በላይ የዲጂታል ገንዘብ ተሰርቋል። አጥቂዎቹ የቪዲዮ ጥሪዎችን በመምሰል እና በቴክኒክ ችግር ሰበብ ጎጂ ሶፍትዌሮችን በማስጫን የተጠቃሚዎችን መረጃ እየሰረቁ ይገኛሉ። ይህ 'FaceStealer' የተሰኘው ዘመቻ በተለይ በቴክኖሎጂ እና በክሪፕቶ ከረንሲ ዘርፍ የሚሰሩ ባለሙያዎችን ኢላማ በማድረግ፣ የተገኘውን ገቢ ለሀገሪቱ የጦር መሳሪያ ፕሮግራም ማዋል መሆኑ ተገልጿል።
oromo: Qorannoon FBI akka ibsetti, hattoonni saaybar gargaarsa mootummaa Kooriyaa Kaabaa qaban, viidiyoo sobaa fayyadamudhaan namoota 900 ol irraa dolaara miiliyoona 400 ol ta'u hataniiru. Hattoonni kun walqunnamtii viidiyoo dhugaa fakkeessuun namoota gowwoomsuu fi sooftiweerii miidhaa geessisu 'audio' fooyyessuuf jedhanii fayyadamuun kompiitara isaanii to'atu. Gochi 'FaceStealer' jedhamu kun keessattuu hojjettoota teeknoolojii fi kiritpoo-karensii irratti xiyyeeffachuun, maallaqa hatame kana sagantaa meeshaa waraanaa biyyattii deeggaruuf akka itti fayyadaman himameera.

title: Who gets to tell the world’s news?
english: Historically, global news coverage has been dominated by a few Western agencies, leading countries in the Global South to seek independent alternatives. In the 1980s, the Non-Aligned News Agencies Pool (NANAP) allowed developing nations to share and report their own stories directly with each other. This movement challenged the Western-centric view of international affairs and continues to highlight the ongoing debate over who controls the global narrative.
amharic: በታሪክ የዓለም የዜና ሽፋን በጥቂት የምዕራባውያን ተቋማት ቁጥጥር ስር የነበረ ሲሆን፣ ይህም የግሎባል ደቡብ አገራት የራሳቸውን አማራጭ እንዲፈልጉ አድርጓቸዋል። በ1980ዎቹ የነበረው 'Non-Aligned News Agencies Pool' (NANAP) ታዳጊ አገራት የራሳቸውን ዜናዎች በቀጥታ እርስ በርስ እንዲለዋወጡ አስችሏቸው ነበር። ይህ እንቅስቃሴ የምዕራባውያንን የአለም አቀፍ የመረጃ የበላይነት በመሞገት፣ የአለምን ትረካ ማን ይቆጣጠር የሚለውን ጥያቄ ዛሬም ድረስ አንስቷል።
oromo: Seenaa keessatti gabaasni oduu addunyaa dhaabbilee dhihaa muraasaa qofaan to'atamaa ture, kunis biyyoonni 'Global South' jedhaman yaada mataa isaanii akka hordofan dirqisiiseera. Bara 1980ota keessa, 'Non-Aligned News Agencies Pool' (NANAP) jedhamuun biyyoonni guddachaa jiran oduu isaanii walitti qajeelatti akka dabarfatan gargaareera. Sochii kana gabaasa oduu irratti dhiibbaa dhihaan qabu mormuun, odeeffannoo addunyaa eenyutu to'ata gaaffii jedhu dhaloota har'aas keessatti kaasaa jira.

title: Nvidia’s Huang, Lutnick summoned to testify to US Senate
english: The U.S. Senate Banking Committee has ordered former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang and Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick to testify regarding a scandal involving potential Chinese espionage and improper technology exports. Huang resigned following reports of an affair with a suspected foreign intelligence asset, prompting lawmakers to investigate whether the company received favorable treatment. The government faces scrutiny over its oversight of semiconductor shipments to China, with officials threatening subpoenas if the witnesses do not appear for scheduled hearings.
amharic: የአሜሪካ ሴኔት የባንክ ኮሚቴ የቀድሞው የኤንቪዲያ ዋና ስራ አስፈፃሚ ጄንሰን ሁዋንግ እና የንግድ ሚኒስትሩ ሃዋርድ ሉጥኒክ ከቻይና የስለላ ድርጊት እና ህገወጥ የቴክኖሎጂ ሽያጭ ጋር በተያያዘ በምርመራ እንዲቀርቡ አዟል። ሁዋንግ ከቻይና ሰላይ ጋር በተገናኘ ቅሌት ምክንያት ስልጣናቸውን የለቀቁ ሲሆን፣ ኩባንያው በመንግስት በኩል ተገቢ ያልሆነ ድጋፍ አግኝቷል ወይ የሚለው ጉዳይ በህግ አውጭዎች እየተጣራ ነው። ሁለቱ ግለሰቦች በታቀደው ጊዜ ካልቀረቡ ህጋዊ እርምጃ እንደሚወሰድባቸው ኮሚቴው አስጠንቅቋል።
oromo: Komiteen Baankii Senaata Ameerikaa, dura ta'aan Nvidia Jensen Huang fi Ministeerri Daldalaa Howard Lutnick shakkii ilaalchisee federaala Chaayinaa fi ergaa teeknooloojii seeraan alaa ta'e irratti qorannoo irratti akka dhiyaatan ajajaniiru. Huang walitti dhufeenya shakkamaa hirdhata Chaayinaa waliin qaban irratti gabaasameen booda hojiirraa kan gagga'an yoo ta'u, law-makers hojiin kun gargaarsa mootummaan argame qabaachuu isaa qorachaa jiru. Namoonni kunneen yoo guyyaa qabameefitti dhiyaachuu baatan tarkaanfiin seeraa akka fudhatamuuf akeekkachiifameera.

title: Washington residents hold vigil after deadly shooting
english: People in Washington, D.C. held a vigil to mourn the victims of a recent shooting incident. The attack resulted in one death and left four other individuals injured. Reports indicate the shooter, 55-year-old Matt Lambert, carried out the violence following an ongoing disagreement with his apartment complex management.
amharic: በዋሽንግተን ዲሲ ነዋሪዎች በቅርቡ በተፈጠረው የተኩስ አደጋ ህይወታቸው ላለፈባቸው ሰዎች የሃዘን ስነ-ስርዓት አካሂደዋል። ጥቃቱ የአንድ ሰው ህይወት ሲያልፍ አራት ሰዎችን ደግሞ ለጉዳት ዳርጓል። የተኩስ አድራሹ ማት ላምበርት የተባለ የ55 ዓመት ግለሰብ ሲሆን፣ ድርጊቱን የፈጸመው ከአፓርታማው አስተዳደር ጋር በነበረው የረጅም ጊዜ አለመግባባት ምክንያት እንደሆነ ተገልጿል።
oromo: Namoonni magaalaa Waashingitan DC keessa jiraatan, dhukaasa dhiheenya kana mudateen lubbuun darbiteef gadda ibsataniiru. Miidhaan kun lubbuu namoota tokkoo yoo galaafatu, namoonni afur immoo madaawaniiru. Ajjeechaa kana kan raawwate Maat Laamberti kan jedhamu umriin isaa waggaa 55 ta'ee, tarkaanfichas kan fudhate bulchiinsa mana isaa waliin wal dhabdee yeroo dheeraa tureef akka ta'e himameera.

title: Australia’s friendly against Jordan moved to Qatar over security concerns
english: The upcoming football match between Australia and Jordan has been relocated from Amman to Doha due to safety concerns. Players requested the venue change following recent security incidents in Jordan, including a stabbing attack and regional military tensions. Both football associations agreed to the move, which is part of Australia’s preparation for the Asian Cup.
amharic: በአውስትራሊያ እና በዮርዳኖስ መካከል ሊካሄድ የነበረው የእግር ኳስ የወዳጅነት ጨዋታ በደህንነት ስጋት ምክንያት ከአማን ወደ ዶሃ ተዛውሯል። በዮርዳኖስ የታዩ የደህንነት ችግሮች እና የጥቃት ክስተቶችን ተከትሎ ተጫዋቾቹ የመጫወቻ ሜዳው እንዲቀየር ጥያቄ አቅርበው ነበር። ሁለቱም ሀገራት በስምምነት ጨዋታውን ወደ ኳታር ለማዛወር የተስማሙ ሲሆን ይህም የአውስትራሊያ የኤዥያ ዋንጫ ዝግጅት አካል ነው።
oromo: Taphi kubbaa miillaa michummaa Awustiraaliyaa fi Joordaan gidduutti taasifamuuf ture sodaa nageenyaa irraa kan ka'e magaalaa Ammaan irraa gara Dohaatti jijjiirameera. Joordaan keessatti walitti bu'iinsa uumamee fi rakkoolee nageenyaa mudatan hordofee, taphattoonni iddoon taphichaa akka jijjiiramu gaafatanii turan. Mootummoonni kubbaa miillaa lamaanuu walii galuudhaan taphicha gara Qaxaritti kan jijjiiran yoo ta'u, kunis qophii Awustiraaliyaan tapha Waancaa Eeshiyaaf gootu keessaa tokko.

title: NBA: Cunningham scores 52 as Pistons win double OT thriller against Wizards
english: Cade Cunningham led the Detroit Pistons to a dramatic 144-140 double-overtime victory over the Washington Wizards by scoring 52 points. He made history by becoming the first player to record at least 50 points and 10 assists in a game without a single turnover. Despite strong performances from the Wizards' star players, Detroit maintained their composure to secure the win after several lead changes.
amharic: ኬድ ካኒንግሃም 52 ነጥቦችን በማስመዝገብ የዲትሮይት ፒስተኖች በዋሽንግተን ዋይዘርድስ ላይ 144 ለ 140 በሆነ ውጤት በሁለት ተጨማሪ የጨዋታ ጊዜዎች እንዲያሸንፉ ረድቷቸዋል። ተጫዋቹ ቢያንስ 50 ነጥብ እና 10 አሲስት በአንድ ጨዋታ ያለ ምንም ስህተት (turnover) በመመዝገብ በኤንቢኤ ታሪክ የመጀመሪያው ሆኗል። የዋሽንግተን ተጫዋቾች ጥሩ ጥረት ቢያደርጉም፣ ዲትሮይት በጨዋታው መጨረሻ ላይ ባሳዩት ብቃት አሸናፊ መሆን ችለዋል።
oromo: Keed Kaningham qabxii 52 galchuun gareen Detrooyit Pistoons garee Waashingitan Wayizardiirraa mo'annoo seena qabeessa ta'e 144-140 kutaalee dabalataa lama booda akka argatu gargaareera. Kaningham tapha tokko keessatti qabxii 50 fi gargaarsa (assist) 10 dogoggora tokko malee galchuun seenaa NBA keessatti jalqabaa ta'eera. Gareen Wayizardi taphattoota ciccimoo qabaatus, Detrooyit xumura irratti jabaachuu danda'uun injifannoo kana galmeeysiteetti.

title: Scandal-hit Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang quits, plunging AI chipmaking giant into turmoil
english: Jensen Huang has resigned as CEO of Nvidia following allegations of extramarital affairs, including one with a woman suspected of being a Chinese intelligence asset. This scandal has caused the company's market value to drop by $550 billion and prompted U.S. lawmakers to launch a national security investigation. The firm is currently under interim leadership while officials face pressure to explain these events to Congress.
amharic: የኤንቪዲያ ዋና ስራ አስፈፃሚ የነበሩት ጄንሰን ሁዋንግ፣ ከጋብቻ ውጪ የነበራቸው ግንኙነቶች ይፋ መሆናቸውን ተከትሎ ከስልጣናቸው ለቀዋል። ከነዚህ ግንኙነቶች አንዱ ከቻይና ሰላይ ጋር የተጠረጠረ መሆኑ ኩባንያውን የብሔራዊ ደህንነት ምርመራ ውስጥ የከተተው ሲሆን፣ በዚህም የኩባንያው የገበያ ዋጋ በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ እንዲቀንስ አድርጓል። በአሁኑ ወቅት ኩባንያው ጊዜያዊ አመራር ተመድቦለት ጉዳዩን ለኮንግረስ ለማስረዳት ከፍተኛ ጫና ውስጥ ይገኛል።
oromo: Hoggantoonni olaanoon Nvidia Jensen Huang, dubartoota biroo wajjin walitti dhufeenya qabaachuu isaanii fi isaan keessa tokko qaama odeeffannoo Chaayinaa ta'uu ishee shakkiin ka'uu isaatiin hojiirraa gadhiisaniiru. Dhimmi kun gatii gabaa dhaabbatichaa biluuya $550 hir'isuun alatti, mootummaan Ameerikaas dhimma nageenya biyyaa irratti qorannoo akka gaggeessu dirqisiiseera. Nvidia ammayyuu hoggansa yeroon gaggeeffamaa jiru yoo ta'u, dhimmi kun gara mana maree bakka buutotaa (Congress) akka geessuuf dhiibbaan godhamaa jira.

title: After Iraq ex-MP’s killing, Lebanon asks Syria to extradite suspects
english: Lebanese authorities have requested that Syria extradite two suspects involved in the murder of former Iraqi lawmaker Ahmed al-Alwani, who was found strangled in a Beirut apartment. While investigators are looking into potential financial motives for the killing, they have already detained one Lebanese citizen for questioning. The Iraqi government is also participating in the probe to help clarify the circumstances surrounding the death of the prominent critic of Iranian influence.
amharic: የሊባኖስ ባለስልጣናት በቤይሩት አፓርታማ ውስጥ ታንቆ የተገኘውን የቀድሞ የኢራቅ ፓርላማ አባል አህመድ አል-አልዋኒን ግድያ ተጠርጣሪ የሆኑ ሁለት የሶሪያ ዜጎችን አሳልፋ እንድትሰጣቸው ሶሪያን ጠይቀዋል። መርማሪዎች የግድያው መነሻ የገንዘብ ጉዳይ ሊሆን እንደሚችል እየመረመሩ ሲሆን፣ ከአደጋው ጋር በተያያዘ አንድ የሊባኖስ ዜጋ በቁጥጥር ስር ውሏል። የኢራቅ መንግስትም በኢራን ተፅእኖ ላይ ከፍተኛ ተቃውሞ የነበረውን የሟቹን ሞት ሁኔታ ለማጣራት በምርመራው እየተሳተፈ ነው።
oromo: Mootummaan Libanon ajjeechaa miseensa duraanii mana maree bakka buutota ummataa Iraaq Ahimed Al-Alwanii kanneen raawwatan jedhaman shakkamtoota lammii Siiriyaa lama akka dabarsituu kennitu Siiriyaa gaafatte. Qaamoleen qorannoo ajjeechaan kun sababa maallaqaa ta'uu danda'a jedhanii shakkuun, nama lammii Libanon tokko qorannoodhaaf to'annoo jala oolchaniiru. Mootummaan Iraaqis namicha dhiibbaa Iraaniin mormaa ture kana ajjeesuu irratti qorannoo godhamuun hirmaachaa jira.

title: Albania’s PM says 2027 NATO summit will not be held in Tirana
english: Albanian Prime Minister Edi Rama has confirmed that the NATO summit will not take place in Tirana in 2027. This decision follows concerns from some NATO members regarding Albania's insufficient defense spending and internal political instability caused by ongoing anti-government protests. While the alliance has not finalized a new location or date, officials suggested that a future summit in Albania remains a possibility for 2028.
amharic: የአልባኒያ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ኤዲ ራማ የኔቶ የመሪዎች ጉባኤ በ2027 በቲራና እንደማይካሄድ አረጋግጠዋል። ይህ ውሳኔ የተላለፈው አንዳንድ የኔቶ አባል ሀገራት በአልባኒያ የመከላከያ በጀት ዝቅተኛነት እና በአገሪቱ ውስጥ በተቀሰቀሰው የፖለቲካ አለመረጋጋት ባላቸው ስጋት ምክንያት ነው። አሊያንስ እስካሁን አዲስ ቦታ ወይም ቀን ባይወስንም፣ ወደፊት በ2028 ጉባኤው በአልባኒያ ሊካሄድ እንደሚችል ፍንጭ ተሰጥቷል።
oromo: Ministirri Muummee Albaniyaa Edi Raamaa, gubaa’iin NATO kan bara 2027 magaalaa Tiraanaa keessatti akka hin gaggeeffamne mirkaneessaniiru. Murtuun kun kan dhufeyyuu biyyoonni miseensa NATO tokko tokko baasii ittisaa Albaniyaa inni xiqqaa ta’uu fi mormii mootummaa mormuun biyyattii keessatti adeemsifamaa jiruun walqabatee yaaddoo qabaachuu isaaniitiin dha. Waldaan NATO hanga ammaa bakkaa fi guyyaa haaraa murteessuu baatus, gara fuulduraatti bara 2028 gubaa’ichi Albaniyaa keessatti gaggeeffamuu akka danda’u ibsameera.

title: Iran war live: Trump says Gulf allies urged pause in Iran strikes
english: President Donald Trump announced that he decided to delay additional military strikes against Iran following requests from Gulf allies. Meanwhile, Saudi Arabia is actively working with Chinese officials to manage rising regional tensions caused by ongoing Houthi attacks on its infrastructure. These developments highlight the complex diplomatic efforts currently underway to prevent further escalation in the Middle East.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ በባህረ ሰላጤው አገራት ጥያቄ መሰረት በኢራን ላይ ሊፈጽሙት የነበረውን ተጨማሪ ወታደራዊ ጥቃት ማዘግየታቸውን አስታውቀዋል። በሌላ በኩል ሳውዲ አረቢያ በሁቲዎች እየደረሰባትን ጥቃት ለመከላከል እና በክልሉ ያለው ውጥረት እንዲቀንስ ከቻይና ዲፕሎማቶች ጋር እየተወያየች ነው። እነዚህ እንቅስቃሴዎች በመካከለኛው ምስራቅ ተጨማሪ ግጭት እንዳይፈጠር እየተደረገ ያለውን ዲፕሎማሲያዊ ጥረት ያሳያሉ።
oromo: Pirezidaanti Doonaald Tiraamp biyyoota galaana garba irraa dhiyeenya qaban gaafatan hordofuun, weerara waraanaa Iran irratti raawwachuuf karoorfate ture yeroodhaaf gadi lakkiseera. Gama biraatiin, Saawudii Arabiyaan haleellaa Hutiin bu'uuraalee misooma ishii irratti raawwatanii fi waldhabdee naannichaa hir'isuuf qondaaltota Chaayinaa wajjin mari'achaa jirti. Tarkaanfiiwwan kun naannoo Baha Giddu-galeessaa keessatti waraanni akka hin babal'anne tattaaffii diippiloomaasii taasifamaa jiru agarsiisu.

title: Yemen’s Houthis renew strikes on Saudi Arabia as UNSC extends sanctions
english: Houthi rebels have launched a series of drone and missile attacks targeting Saudi Arabia's oil and military infrastructure. In response, the Saudi-led coalition claims to have intercepted several of these threats while continuing their own military campaign against the group. Meanwhile, the United Nations Security Council has decided to keep sanctions against the Houthis in place.
amharic: የሁቲ ታጣቂዎች በሳውዲ አረቢያ የነዳጅ ማጣሪያ እና ወታደራዊ ተቋማት ላይ የድሮን እና የሚሳኤል ጥቃቶችን ከፍተዋል። በምላሹ፣ በሳውዲ የሚመራው ጥምረት ጥቃቶቹን እንደከለከለ እና በቡድኑ ላይ የሚያደርገውን ወታደራዊ ዘመቻ እንደቀጠለ አስታውቋል። በተመሳሳይ ጊዜ የተባበሩት መንግስታት የጸጥታው ምክር ቤት በሁቲ ታጣቂዎች ላይ የጣለውን ማዕቀብ ማራዘሙን አረጋግጧል።
oromo: Humni Houthii lafarraafi qilleensa irraa meeshaalee waraanaa fi bu'uraalee misoomaa Sa'udii Arabiyaa irratti weerara bananiiru. Gama biraatiin, waraanni Sa'udiin durfamu weeraroota kanneen ofirraa ittisuu isaa fi duula waraanaa Houthii irratti gaggeessaa jiru itti fufuusaa beeksiseera. Haaluma kanaan, Mana Maree Nageenyaa Dhaabbata Mootummoota Gamtoomanii tarkaanfii sanadaa Houthii irratti fudhatame akka dheeratu murteesseera.

title: Russian court jails rights lawyer for 12 years on treason charge
english: A Russian court in Kaliningrad has sentenced 66-year-old human rights lawyer Maria Bontsler to 12 years in prison on treason charges. Prosecutors alleged she shared sensitive information regarding security officials and local criminal cases with Ukraine. Her legal team argued the evidence was not classified, and criticized the secretive nature of the trial, noting that Bontsler was largely excluded from the proceedings.
amharic: የሩሲያ ፍርድ ቤት ማሪያ ቦንትስለር የተባሉ የ66 ዓመት የሰብአዊ መብት ጠበቃን በአገር ክህደት ወንጀል የ12 ዓመት እስራት ፈርዶባቸዋል። አቃቤ ህጎች ጠበቃዋ ከካሊኒንግራድ የጸጥታ አካላት ጋር የተያያዙ ሚስጥራዊ መረጃዎችን ለዩክሬን አሳልፈው ሰጥተዋል ሲሉ ከሰዋቸዋል። የመከላከያ ጠበቆቻቸው የቀረበው መረጃ ሚስጥራዊ አለመሆኑን በመግለጽ የፍርድ ሂደቱ በዝግ መካሄዱን እና ተከሳሡ በችሎቱ ላይ መገኘት አለመቻላቸውን በመተቸት ውሳኔውን ተቃውመዋል።
oromo: Mana murtii Raashiyaatti, abukaatoo mirga namummaa kan ta'an umuriin isaanii 66 kan ta'e Maria Bontsler irratti himata gantummaa irratti hunda'uun hidhaa waggaa 12 itti murteesseera. Himatamtootni kunneen odeeffannoo nageenyaa fi dhimmoota yakkaa naannichaa gara Yukreenitti dabarsaniiru jechuun himataman. Gareen abukaatoota ishee odeeffannoon kun iccitii akka hin taane fi dhaddachi kun karaa iftoomina hin qabneen gaggeeffamuun isaa sirrii akka hin taane ibsaniiru.

title: Russian warship hit by Ukrainian drone in Gulf of Finland
english: Ukrainian drones recently struck a Russian warship in the Gulf of Finland, marking an unusual expansion of hostilities into the Baltic Sea. The targeted vessel, a small corvette capable of carrying cruise missiles, was reportedly forced to return to St. Petersburg for repairs. While Finnish officials confirmed the incident, they reassured the public that regional maritime traffic remains safe and stable.
amharic: የዩክሬን ድሮኖች በፊንላንድ ባሕረ ሰላጤ ውስጥ በሚገኝ የሩሲያ የጦር መርከብ ላይ ጥቃት አድርሰዋል፣ ይህም ጦርነቱ ወደ ባልቲክ ባሕር መዛመቱን ያሳያል። ጥቃቱ የተፈጸመበት የጦር መርከብ ጉዳት እንደደረሰበት እና ወደ ሴንት ፒተርስበርግ ወደብ መመለሱ ተዘግቧል። የፊንላንድ ባለሥልጣናት ክስተቱን ያረጋገጡ ሲሆን፣ በክልሉ ያለው የባህር ጉዞ ደህንነት የተጠበቀ መሆኑን አረጋግጠዋል።
oromo: Diroonni Yukreenin hogganaman tokko galaana Finlaand keessatti doonii waraana Raashiyaa irratti haleellaa raawwataniiru; kunis waraanni kun gara galaana Baaltikitti babal'achuu isaa agarsiisa. Dooniin waraanaa haleellaan kun irratti raawwatamee fi meeshaa waraanaa gurguddaa baachuu danda'u, miidhaa erga irra ga'ee booda gara buufata seent Piitarsbargiitti deebi'uu isaa gabaafameera. Aangeyyoonni Finlaand haleellaa kana mirkaneessan iyyuu, nagaan daandii galaanaa naannichaa eegamaa akka ta'e ibsaniiru.

title: Suspected bomb hoax threats force fresh evacuations of Italian schools
english: Schools across Italy have faced a second day of widespread bomb threats sent via email, forcing authorities to conduct further evacuations despite no explosives being discovered. The government has advised that schools should not be cleared unless there is concrete evidence of danger, while Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni has promised to develop clearer safety protocols. Investigators believe the messages, which have also affected other European countries, are hoaxes originating from hacked accounts or suspicious sources.
amharic: በኢጣሊያ የሚገኙ ትምህርት ቤቶች ለሁለተኛ ቀን በተከታታይ በኢሜይል በተላኩ የሐሰት የቦምብ ማስፈራሪያዎች ምክንያት ተማሪዎችን ለቀው እንዲወጡ ተገደዋል። ምንም እንኳን እስካሁን ፍንዳታዎች ባይገኙም መንግሥት ትምህርት ቤቶች ተጨባጭ ማስረጃ ሳይኖር ባዶ መሆን እንደሌለባቸው አሳስቧል። ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ጆርጂያ ሜሎኒ ለወደፊቱ ግልጽ የሆነ የደህንነት መመሪያ እንደሚያወጡ ቃል የገቡ ሲሆን ባለስልጣናት ማስፈራሪያዎቹ የጠለፋ ወንጀል ውጤት እንደሆኑ ጠርጥረዋል።
oromo: Mana barumsaa Itoaliyaa keessatti guyyaa lammaffaaf itti aansuun dhaadannoon boombii imeelii irraa ergamee sodaa uumee jira. Hanga ammaatti boombiileen argamus hin jiru ta'us, mootummaan ragaan dhugaa tokko utuu hin jiraatin mana barumsaa gadi lakkisiisuun akka hin barbaachisne gorseera. Ministirri Muummee Joorjiyaa Meelooniin qajeelfama tasgabbii foyyee qabu akka baasan waadaa seenan; qorattoonni imeeliiwwan kun hundi soba fi accountiiwwan hack ta'an irraa kan dhufan ta'uu shakka.

title: Hegseth awards medal to war memorial guard who reprimanded him and group
english: US Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth recently awarded a medal to an Arlington National Cemetery guard who previously scolded him for being loud. During a Veterans Day event, the guard intervened when Hegseth’s group was talking and laughing near the Tomb of the Unknown Soldier. By presenting the honor, Hegseth aimed to publicly praise the soldier for upholding the cemetery's strict standards of silence and respect.
amharic: የአሜሪካ መከላከያ ሚኒስትር ፒት ሄግሴዝ በአርሊንግተን ብሔራዊ መቃብር ስፍራ በድምፅ በመነጋገራቸው የገሰጻቸውን የጦር ሰራዊት አባል ሜዳሊያ ሰጥተው አክብረዋል። የጦር መታሰቢያ ስፍራው ጠባቂው ሄግሴዝ እና ቡድናቸው በማይታወቅ ወታደር መቃብር አቅራቢያ ሳቁ እና አወሩ በሚል ለሥነ-ሥርዓት አስገንዝቧቸው ነበር። ሚኒስትሩ ይህንን ሽልማት የሰጡት ወታደሩ የቦታውን ክብር ለመጠበቅ ላሳየው ጥብቅ ዲሲፕሊን ያላቸውን አድናቆት ለመግለጽ ነው።
oromo: Ministirri Raayyaa Ittisa Biyya Amerikaa Pete Hegseth, naannoo bakka yaadannoo waraanaa Arlingtonitti sagalee ol kaasuudhaan kan isa dheekkame eegduu tokkoof badhaasa kenneera. Guyyaa Waraanaatti, Hegseth fi gareen isaa bakka awwaala waraana beekamtootaa hin taane biratti yeroo taphatanii fi dubbatan eegduun kun nagaa akka eegan isaan gorse ture. Hegseth badhaasa kana kan kenne, eegduun kun sirna bakka sanaa eegsisuuf gootummadhaan seera kabajchiisuu isaa akka dinqisiifatu ibsuufi.

title: Microsoft outage hits tens of thousands of users
english: A major technical failure caused a widespread disruption to Microsoft services, including Outlook, Teams, and Copilot, affecting tens of thousands of users globally. The company reported that its servers unexpectedly went offline and failed health checks. Microsoft engineers are currently working to fix the issue by redistributing network traffic and restarting the affected systems.
amharic: በማይክሮሶፍት አገልጋዮች ላይ በተፈጠረ የቴክኒክ ችግር ምክንያት Outlook፣ Teams እና Copilotን ጨምሮ የተለያዩ አገልግሎቶች በዓለም ዙሪያ ተስተጓጉለዋል። ኩባንያው ችግሩ የተፈጠረው አገልጋዮቹ በድንገት ከመስመር ውጪ በመሆናቸው እንደሆነ ገልጿል። የማይክሮሶፍት ባለሙያዎች የተጨናነቀውን የኔትወርክ ትራፊክ በማስተካከል እና የተጎዱ ስርዓቶችን እንደገና በማስጀመር አገልግሎቱን ወደነበረበት ለመመለስ ጥረት እያደረጉ ነው።
oromo: Rakkoo teeknikaa mudateen tajaajilootni Maaykiroosoft kanneen akka Outlook, Teams fi Copilot addunyaa maratti addaan citanii turan. Kampiiniin kun akka ibsetti, rakkoon kun kan uumame kaardiiwwan (servers) isaanii tasa hojii dhaabuu irraa kan ka'e dha. Ogeeyyiin Maaykiroosoft tajaajiloota kana gara hojiitti deebisuuf jecha, traafika interneetii sirreeffachaa fi sirnoota miidhaman irra deebi'anii kaasuu irratti hojjechaa jiru.

title: Pope Leo calls for Church to make ‘amends’ to sex abuse victims
english: Pope Leo XIV has urged the Catholic Church to address the issue of clergy-led sexual abuse with transparency and justice. During a meeting with bishops in Peru, he emphasized the necessity of compensating victims for their suffering. Furthermore, he called for the implementation of stricter safeguards to protect individuals and ensure such misconduct does not happen again.
amharic: ርዕሰ ሊቃነ ጳጳሳት ሊዮ አሥራ አራተኛ የካቶሊክ ቤተ ክርስቲያን በካህናት የሚፈጸምን የጾታ ጥቃት በእውነት፣ በፍትህ እና በተጠያቂነት መቅረፍ እንዳለባት አሳስበዋል። በፔሩ ከሚገኙ ጳጳሳት ጋር ባደረጉት ውይይት፣ ቤተ ክርስቲያኒቱ ለተጎጂዎች ካሳ የመክፈል እና የሚደርሰውን በደል የመካስ ግዴታ እንዳለባት ገልጸዋል። በተጨማሪም፣ ለወደፊቱ ተመሳሳይ ጥቃቶችን ለመከላከል የሚያስችሉ ጠንካራ መከላከያዎችን መዘርጋት እንደሚያስፈልግ አጽንኦት ሰጥተዋል።
oromo: Pappaan Li'oo kudha afraffaan, waldaan Katolikaa miidhaa saalqunnamtii lubootaan raawwatamu dhugaa, haqaa fi itti gaafatamummaadhaan akka ilaaltu gaafataniiru. Piroo keessatti biishopota waliin yeroo mari’atan, waldaan miidhamtootaaf beenyaa kaffaluu fi miidhaa isaanirra ga’e sirreessuu akka qabdu ibsaniiru. Dabalataanis, gara fuulduraatti gochi akkasii akka hin raawwatamneef eegumsa cimaa godhuun akka barbaachisu dhaamaniiru.

title: US releases report on $12bn from Venezuelan oil, mineral resources
english: The U.S. State Department has published a report detailing how it has managed over $12 billion in revenue from Venezuelan oil and mineral exports since the U.S.-led removal of President Nicolas Maduro earlier this year. The Trump administration currently controls these funds through special bank accounts, stating that the move is intended to ensure financial transparency. However, activists have raised concerns that the U.S. may be prioritizing these profits over the promotion of democratic governance in Venezuela.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የውጭ ጉዳይ መሥሪያ ቤት ባለፈው ዓመት ፕሬዚዳንት ኒኮላስ ማዱሮ ከስልጣን ከተወገዱ በኋላ ከቬኔዙዌላ ዘይት እና ማዕድን የተገኘን ከ12 ቢሊዮን ዶላር በላይ የገቢ ምንጭ እንዴት እንደተቆጣጠረ የሚያሳይ ሪፖርት አውጥቷል። የአሜሪካ መንግሥት ገንዘቡን በልዩ የባንክ ሂሳቦች አማካኝነት በቁጥጥሩ ስር ያዋለው ለግልጽነት ዓላማ እንደሆነ ገልጿል። ይሁን እንጂ፣ የሰብአዊ መብት ተሟጋቾች አሜሪካ ለዴሞክራሲያዊ ለውጥ ከመስራት ይልቅ ለገቢው ትኩረት እየሰጠች ነው የሚል ስጋታቸውን እየገለጹ ነው።
oromo: Mootummaan Ameerikaa, erga pirezidaant Niikolaas Maaduuroon aangoo irraa buufamanii as, qabeenya daldala boba'aa fi albuudaa Veenezueelaa irraa argame dolaara biiliyoona 12 ol ta'u akkamitti akka hordofaa jiru ibsuun gabaasa baaseera. Mootummaan Trump qabeenya kana herreega baankii addaa keessa kaa'uudhaan akkaataa itti fayyadama isaa ifa gochuuf yaalii gochaa jiraachuu ibseera. Ta'us, gareewwan mirga namoomaa fi sabboonummaa, Ameerikaan dimookiraasii Veenezueelaa keessatti ijaaruu caalaa bu'aa qabeenya kanaa irratti xiyyeeffachuu isheetiin yaaddoo qaban ibsaniiru.

title: What’s at stake in the renewed tensions over the Falkland Islands?
english: Argentina and the United Kingdom are engaged in a new legal conflict concerning oil exploration activities near the Falkland Islands. Argentina argues that these drilling operations should not proceed until the long-standing ownership dispute over the territory is officially settled. Meanwhile, the British government maintains its full authority over the islands and rejects Argentina's attempt to block the project.
amharic: አርጀንቲና እና እንግሊዝ በፎልክላንድ ደሴቶች አቅራቢያ በሚካሄድ የነዳጅ ፍለጋ ፕሮጀክት ምክንያት በአዲስ የህግ ክርክር ውስጥ ገብተዋል። አርጀንቲና በደሴቶቹ ባለቤትነት ላይ ስምምነት እስኪደረስ ድረስ የቁፋሮ ስራዎች መቆም አለባቸው ብላ ታምናለች። የብሪታንያ መንግስት በበኩሉ በደሴቶቹ ላይ ሙሉ ስልጣን እንዳለው በመግለጽ የአርጀንቲናን ተቃውሞ ውድቅ አድርጎታል።
oromo: Arjantiinanii fi biyyi Ingiliiz bakka naannoo gubbaa bishaan gadii kan Falklaandi jedhamuutti hojii qorannoo boba'aa irratti wal-dhabdee seeraa keessa galanii jiru. Arjantiinaan dhimmi abbummaa lafa kanaa hanga furamuutti hojiin boba'aa kun dhaabbachuu qaba jettee falmiti. Gama biraatiin, mootummaan Ingiliiz lafa kana irratti aangoo guutuu qabaachuusaa mirkaneessuun, mormii Arjantiinaa fudhatama dhabsiiseera.

title: Qatar Under-17 World Cup is on despite US pull out
english: The Under-17 World Cup in Qatar is set to begin next week as planned, even though the United States has decided not to participate. Although US Soccer officials cited security worries for their withdrawal, FIFA president Gianni Infantino has assured everyone that the host nation remains a safe environment for all teams and spectators. The tournament will move forward without the American team.
amharic: የዩናይትድ ስቴትስ ቡድን በውድድሩ ላይ ላለመሳተፍ ቢወስንም፣ በኳታር የሚካሄደው ከ17 ዓመት በታች የዓለም ዋንጫ እንደታቀደው በሚቀጥለው ሳምንት ይጀመራል። የአሜሪካ እግር ኳስ ፌዴሬሽን ለውሳኔው የደህንነት ስጋትን ምክንያት አድርጓል። ሆኖም የፊፋ ፕሬዝዳንት ጃኒ ኢንፋንቲኖ አስተናጋጅ አገሪቱ ለቡድኖችም ሆነ ለተመልካቾች አስተማማኝ እንደሆነች አረጋግጠዋል።
oromo: gareen Ameerikaa dorgommii kana irratti hirmaachuu baatus, Waancaan Addunyaa U-17 Qaataritti qabame akkaataa karooraatiin torban dhufu jalqaba. Ta'us, pirezedantiin FIFA Jaanii Infantinoo biyyi keessummeessituun kun gareewwaniifi daawwattootaaf tasgabbii kan qabdu ta'uu mirkaneessaniiru.

title: 'No light, no water, no heat': Ukrainians struggle with blackouts as Russia hits power grid
english: Ukrainians are facing severe daily life disruptions as Russian strikes on the energy grid cause widespread, extended power outages. Families are struggling with limited access to electricity, heating, and running water, with some areas experiencing up to 20 hours without power each day. This crisis has made living conditions increasingly difficult, forcing residents to endure cold and dark homes as the winter weather intensifies.
amharic: ሩሲያ በዩክሬን የኃይል ማመንጫዎች ላይ በምትፈጽመው ጥቃት ምክንያት የዩክሬን ህዝብ ለከባድ የኤሌክትሪክ መቆራረጥ ተዳርገዋል። ቤተሰቦች ለረጅም ሰዓታት ያህል ኤሌክትሪክ፣ ማሞቂያ እና ንጹህ ውሃ ሳያገኙ በመቸገራቸው የዕለት ተዕለት ኑሮአቸው በእጅጉ ተጎድቷል። አንዳንዶቹ አካባቢዎች በቀን እስከ 20 ሰዓታት በጨለማ የሚያሳልፉ ሲሆን፣ ቀዝቃዛው የክረምት ወቅት ሁኔታውን ይበልጥ አስቸጋሪ አድርጎታል።
oromo: Raashiyaan buufataalee humna elektirikii Yuukireen irratti haleellaa geggeessaa jirtuun wal qabatee, ummanni biyyattii rakkoo guddaa keessa galanii jiru. Maatiiwwan hedduun ibsaa, bishaanii fi ho’a argachuu dadhabuun guyyaa guyyaan rakkoo cimaa keessa jiru. Magaalota tokko tokko keessatti ibsiin hanga sa'aatii 20f kan dhaabatu yoo ta'u, kunis qorra cimaa waliin ta'ee jireenya uummataa caalaatti ulfaata taasiseera.

title: Millions of Ebola dollars going missing as virus spreads, medical charity warns
english: A medical charity, MSF, has raised alarms that hundreds of millions of dollars intended for the Ebola response in the Democratic Republic of Congo are missing or mismanaged. While the outbreak remains severe with thousands of deaths, frontline workers are reportedly lacking basic supplies, proper training, and consistent pay. The organization is calling on the government and the UN to improve financial oversight to ensure that resources actually reach the areas and personnel where they are desperately needed.
amharic: የህክምና በጎ አድራጎት ድርጅት የሆነው ኤምኤስኤፍ (MSF) በኮንጎ ዲሞክራቲክ ሪፐብሊክ ለኢቦላ መከላከል ስራ የተመደበው በመቶ ሚሊዮኖች የሚቆጠር ዶላር ጥቅም ላይ ሳይውል መቅረቱን ወይም በአግባቡ አለመያዙን አስታውቋል። ወረርሽኙ አሁንም በከፍተኛ ደረጃ እየተስፋፋ ቢሆንም፣ በግንባር ቀደምትነት የሚሰሩ የጤና ባለሙያዎች አስፈላጊ የሆኑ የህክምና መሳሪያዎች፣ ስልጠና እና ደመወዝ እያጡ ይገኛሉ። ድርጅቱ መንግስት እና የተባበሩት መንግስታት ድርጅት ገንዘቡ ለታለመለት አላማ እንዲውል እና የጤና ባለሙያዎችን እንዲደግፉ ጥሪ አቅርቧል።
oromo: Dhaabbanni gargaarsa yaala fayyaa MSF jedhamu, maallaqni qophiif ramadamee ture kan biyyoota dhibba hedduu ga'u biyya Kongo keessatti karaa irra hin oolin ykn qisaasa'uun isaa gabaaseera. Dhibichi kan hin to'atamne ta'us, hojjattoonni fayyaa sadarkaa duraa irratti argaman meeshaalee barbaachisoo, leenjii fi kaffaltii waggaa dhabuun isaanii ibsameera. Dhaabbatichi mootummaan fi tokkummaan mootummoota gamtoomanii maallaqni kun gara namoota isa barbaadanii akka gahuuf to'annoo cimaa akka godhan gaafateera.

title: Ukraine says military Starlink disrupted again as US envoys meet Putin in Moscow
english: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky reports that military-grade Starlink services are experiencing recurring disruptions, hindering the country's ability to defend against Russian drone attacks. Simultaneously, American envoys Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff have traveled to Moscow for direct discussions with Vladimir Putin regarding potential peace negotiations. These diplomatic meetings, which also include scheduled talks with Zelensky, come as Ukraine struggles with technical connectivity issues and seeks clarity from US officials.
amharic: የዩክሬኑ ፕሬዚዳንት ቮሎዲሚር ዘለንስኪ በጦር ሜዳ ጥቅም ላይ የሚውለው የስታርሊንክ አገልግሎት እንደገና መስተጓጎሉን ገልጸዋል፤ ይህም ሀገሪቱ በሩሲያ ድሮኖች ላይ የምታደርገውን የመከላከል ስራ አስቸጋሪ አድርጎታል። ይህ በሆነበት ወቅት የአሜሪካውያን ልዑካን ጃሬድ ኩሽነር እና ስቲቭ ዊትኮፍ ከቭላድሚር ፑቲን ጋር በሞስኮ ለመወያየት ተገናኝተዋል። የዲፕሎማሲው ጥረት የዩክሬን-ሩሲያ ግጭትን ለመፍታት ያለመ ቢሆንም፣ የቴክኖሎጂው መስተጓጎል በዩክሬን ወታደራዊ አቅም ላይ ስጋት ፈጥሯል።
oromo: Pirezidantiin Yukreen Volodimir Zeleniski tajaajilli Starlink waraanaaf fayyadu irra deddeebiin addaan citee akka jiru ibsan; kunis dandeettii biyyattiin miila waraana Raashiyaa ofirraa ittisuuf qabdu irratti dhiibbaa geessiseera. Yeroo wal fakkaataatti, ergamtoonni Ameerikaa Jaared Kushnar fi Stiv Witkof marii nagaa irratti xiyyeeffate gaggeessuuf pirezidanti Vladimir Puutiin wajjin Moskootti wal arganiiru. Hojiin dipilomaasii kun waraana Yukreen fi Raashiyaa xumuruuf kan qabame ta'us, dhimmi Starlink kun humna ittisa Yukreen irratti rakkoo uumaa jira.

title: More than 1,800 Italian schools targeted by new hoax bomb alerts
english: Over 1,800 schools across Italy were forced to close after receiving fake bomb threats via email, following similar alerts that affected thousands of schools the previous day. Authorities confirmed the threats were hoaxes, prompting the government to advise against mass evacuations unless a genuine danger is identified. The incident has intensified political debate in Italy regarding the country's cybersecurity preparedness against evolving hybrid warfare threats.
amharic: ከ1,800 በላይ የጣሊያን ትምህርት ቤቶች በኢሜይል በተላኩ የሐሰት የቦምብ ማስፈራሪያዎች ምክንያት ተዘግተው ነበር። ባለስልጣናት ማስፈራሪያዎቹ ሀሰተኛ መሆናቸውን በመግለጽ፣ ትምህርት ቤቶች ትክክለኛ አደጋ ካልተረጋገጠ በስተቀር እንቅስቃሴያቸውን እንዲቀጥሉ መክረዋል። ይህ ድርጊት በጣሊያን የሳይበር ደህንነት ዝግጁነት ላይ ከፍተኛ የፖለቲካ ክርክር አስነስቷል።
oromo: Mana barnootaa Itoaliyaa 1,800 ol ta'an ergaa xalayaa sobaa boombii fayyadamee gara garaa ergameen walqabatee cufamuuf dirqamaniiru. Aangeyyoonni ergaawwan kunneen dhuga-malee ta'uu mirkaneessanii, hamma balaan dhugaa ta'e tokko hin mirkanaa'etti mana barnootaa cufuun akka hin barbaachisne ibsaniiru. Gochi kun biyyattiin miidhaa qaxxaamuraa (hybrid warfare) ittisuuf dandeettii 'cybersecurity' qabdu irratti falmii siyaasaa cimaa uumeera.

title: FIFA Under-17 World Cup to kick off in Qatar despite US withdrawal
english: The FIFA Under-17 World Cup is set to begin in Qatar on November 19 as originally planned, despite the United States withdrawing its team over safety concerns. The US Soccer Federation cited a Level 3 travel advisory regarding potential regional conflict as the reason for their decision. However, FIFA has reaffirmed that it sees no security threats and remains confident in the safety measures currently in place in Qatar.
amharic: የፊፋ ከ17 ዓመት በታች የዓለም ዋንጫ ውድድር አሜሪካ በጸጥታ ስጋት ምክንያት ቡድኗን ብታወጣም፣ እንደታቀደው በኳታር ህዳር 10 ቀን ይጀምራል። የአሜሪካ እግር ኳስ ፌዴሬሽን ውሳኔውን የወሰነው በክልሉ ስላለው የጸጥታ ሁኔታ በወጣው የጉዞ ማስጠንቀቂያ ምክንያት ነው። ይሁን እንጂ ፊፋ በበኩሉ በኳታር ያለው የጸጥታ ሁኔታ የተረጋጋ መሆኑን ገልጾ፣ ውድድሩ እንደታቀደው እንደሚካሄድ አረጋግጧል።
oromo: Waancaa Addunyaa FIFA umrii waggaa 17 gadii, gareen Ameerikaa yaaddoo nageenyaa irraa kan ka'e hirmaannaa isaa haquu isaatiin ala, akka sagantaa isaatti Sadaasa 19 biyya Kaataritti kan jalqabu ta'a. Federeeshiniin Ispoortii Kubbaa Miilaa Ameerikaa murtee kana kan dabarse gorsa imalaafi nageenyaa naannichaa irratti hundaa'uudhaan dha. Ta'us, FIFA naannichi nageenya kan qabu ta'uu mirkaneessuun, qophiin akkasumas gaggeessan taphichaas akkuma duraan karoorfamee kan itti fufu ta'uu beeksiseera.

title: Canada won’t let Russian players enter for ice hockey junior championship
english: The Canadian government has officially banned Russian and Belarusian athletes and officials from entering the country for the upcoming World Junior Ice Hockey Championship. Despite a recent ruling by the Court of Arbitration for Sport suggesting Russian teams should be readmitted, Ottawa is refusing entry due to ongoing opposition to the war in Ukraine. Officials confirmed that even those holding valid visas will be denied access to ensure Russian teams cannot participate in the tournament.

oromo: Mootummaan Kanaadaa taphattootaa fi hoggantoota ispoortii biyyoota Raashiyaa fi Beelaaruus dorgommii qorraa irratti taphatamuuf jiru irratti hirmaachuuf gara biyyattii akka hin seenne dhorkeera. Manni murtii falmii ispoortii addunyaa gareen Raashiyaa dorgommicha irratti akka hirmaatu murteesse iyyuu, Kanaadaan waraana Yukreen irratti gaggeeffamaa jiru mormuudhaan murtee kana fudhachuu dideetti. Mootummaan Kanaadaa namoonni viizaa sirrii qaban iyyuu gara biyyattii seenuu akka hin dandeenye fi gareen Raashiyaa dorgommicha irratti hirmaachuu akka hin dandeenye ibseera.
